titlu: File:Hand holds house keys near door lock, symbolizing new beginnings and homeownership journey in a modern setting.jpg
descriere_commons: A hand is positioned to insert house keys into a door lock, representing the exciting moment of entering a new home. The keys feature a house shape, emphasizing ownership.
